jobs.description: About usIn 2022, Instabee was founded through the combination of Instabox and Budbee — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy.Today, Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries, with the ambition to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. We move fast — both when it comes to delivering parcels and growing our business. From Sweden, we have expanded across Scandinavia and into continental Europe, with further growth ahead.As our business continues to grow, so does the complexity of our financial operations. We are now looking for a full-time Accounts Payable Accountant to join our global Finance team and play an important role in our continued growth.About the roleAs an Accounts Payable Accountant, you will be an important part of our Accounting team, responsible for day-to-day AP activities across our Swedish and international entities. You will help ensure that invoices are processed accurately and on time, payments are handled efficiently, and vendor relationships are well managed.You will work closely with colleagues across Finance and stakeholders throughout the organisation, giving you broad exposure to our international business. We are on an exciting journey of developing and modernising our current processes, with a strong focus on leveraging AI, and you will play an active part in shaping this transformation.Your responsibilities    Verify, process and record vendor invoices for Swedish and international Instabee entities    Ensure invoices are correctly coded, approved and recorded    Manage and book vendor payments    Perform account reconciliations and follow up on outstanding items    Handle vendor queries and invoice- and payment-related questions    Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely approvals    Support month-end closing, AP reporting and reconciliations    Maintain accurate vendor records and documentation    Identify opportunities to improve and streamline AP processes    Work closely with the Accounting and Controlling teams and support other accounting activities when needed    Support the development and improvement of AP processes through the adoption of AI and automation toolsAbout youWe are looking for a proactive and solution-oriented person with a can-do mentality who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and get things done.You have a genuine interest in accounting and enjoy working in a role where accuracy, structure and attention to detail are important. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work well independently and enjoy collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders.We believe you have    A degree or relevant education in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field    Previous experience in Accounts Payable or a similar accounting role    A good understanding of accounting principles and invoice processes    Experience with an ERP or accounting system    A structured, detail-oriented and organised approach    Strong communication and collaboration skills    A proactive mindset and willingness to learn and improve    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is an advantageWhat we offerAt Instabee, you will join a talented and collaborative Finance team in a fast-moving international company. You will be trusted with responsibility, challenged to develop your skills and given the opportunity to make an impact. We offer a varied role within our global Finance organisation, exposure to international operations, and the opportunity to help improve our processes as we continue to scale. The journey ahead is exciting for everyone at Instabee — and we are just getting started. Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Dogs are welcome in designated dog-friendly rooms within the office.🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.  We are now looking for a Bartender to join our food & beverage team to ensure exceptional customer service as we align the hotel as one of the top luxury hotels in Stockholm post-renovation. If you have a passion for hospitality and a focus on delivering outstanding guest experiences, we want to hear from you!We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for professional development. Whether you are starting your journey in hospitality or looking to take the next step in your career, we offer a workplace where you can learn, grow, and thrive. Key Responsibilities: •    Prepare and serve a variety of beverages to the highest standard•    Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, assuring personalised service and addressing guest concerns or needs promptly,ensuring a memorable experience for every guest•    Engage with guests in a warm and professional manner, anticipating their needs and preferences•    Ensure consistent quality in beverage preparation •    Ensure effective communication and collaboration with other teams and departmentsQualifications:•    At least 3 years of experience working in an international cocktail bar•    A solid general knowledge of beverages•    A driven attitude and an eye for detail•    Ability to handle high-pressure situations with efficiency and professionalism•    A strong guest focus and takes satisfaction in delivering high-level service•    A team-oriented mindset, but with the ability to work independently and show initiative•    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English; additional languages are a plus What We Offer:•    A permanent full-time position following the 6-month probation period and we adhere to collective agreements•    Chance of being part of one of the biggest renovation and re-positioning projects in Stockholm’s hotel scene•    Employment in a company with great opportunities for growth•    A dynamic and inclusive work environment•    Employee discounted rates at over 8500+ hotels worldwide Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests! Working hours follow a rotating schedule, including weekdays, evenings, and weekends according to the hotel's needs. In addition, a valid Swedish work permit is required. The Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.Redefining the Essence of HospitalityWe have recently started our much-anticipated renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm. This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We will transform all our spaces, hotel rooms, implement new food and beverage concepts and expand our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.About Archer Hotel ManagementArcher Hotel Management (AHM) is the operational arm of Archer Hotel Capital (AHC), committed to pioneering sustainable management of upscale and luxury hotels in Europe. AHM is dedicated to making a 'world of difference,' empowering teams to foster entrepreneurial cultures and deliver operational excellence. Our commitment includes achieving net zero carbon emissions by 2030 and gaining third-party certification for sustainable practices.

About VolumentalVolumental is a FitTech™ company used by footwear brands and retailers, matching people with shoes that truly fit through 3D scanning and machine learning.Our vision is "a world without sizes, where every body fits". We work with brands like New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world's largest datasets of its kind.We've always been an AI company at our core. Today, that extends beyond the product into how we build, using AI agents and strong self-serve tooling to move faster from idea to production. Where you fit in  Every scan in every one of those stores, and every recommendation we give, depends on infrastructure that has to work while a shopper is standing in front of a clerk. Our platform runs on Kubernetes on Google Cloud, is managed as code, is deployed through GitOps, and is observed through Grafana. What we’re looking for is someone who treats that platform as a product: one our developers can self-serve on, that holds up when things go wrong, and that is ready for new kinds of workloads.This is a hands-on Platform Engineer role. Most days you'll be shipping and running infrastructure with Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD, keeping an eye on our systems through Grafana, and building tools in Go that let developers get what they need without waiting on anyone. You'll also spend time explaining technical tradeoffs and writing docs that others can act on.AI is changing the industry, and we see it as an opportunity to empower people. By automating toil and mechanical tasks across the organisation, people can focus on the architectural, novel, and creative work. You will be right at the centre of this transformation, enabling not only yourself and your team’s work, but ensuring that the company can leverage AI and accelerate as a whole.Things you'll do:     Ship and run production infrastructure on Kubernetes and GCP, managed as code with Terraform and deployed with Helm and ArgoCD    Define SLOs and build monitoring and alerting in Grafana that tells us when stores and shoppers are actually affected    Take part in on-call, lead incident response, and run postmortems that turn into real fixes    Build tools in Go that let developers self-serve on environments, deployments and access    Explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product managers and leadership, and write documentation others can act on    Leverage AI agents to compress routine work, redirecting the time saved into reliability and platform improvements    Help strengthen how we handle access, secrets, certificates and image security alongside the wider teamWe are excited about you because:    You have 3+ years of experience running production infrastructure in an SRE, DevOps or Platform role    You've been on-call for production systems on Kubernetes and a major cloud provider, ideally GCP, and have led incident response and postmortems    You can set up SLO-based monitoring and alerting, and you're comfortable managing infrastructure as code with Terraform    You write clean, maintainable, cloud-native code in at least one language such as Go or Python    You have solid systems knowledge and troubleshoot methodically across the stack    You're comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy finding the right problem and seeing it throughBonus - Don't let these stop you from applying, but please let us know if you have experience with:    Deploying and running AI agent workloads and tool servers (such as MCP), with sandboxing, rate limiting and observability of agent actions    Security: identity and access management, authentication (OAuth/OIDC, SSO), certificate and TLS/mTLS management, secrets handling, network hardening, vulnerability management, and image hardening and scanning    Compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR    Database operations and migrations    Running workloads across multiple cloud providers or regulated regions What we can offer you:    Personal learning budget and access to coaching    Opportunity to work with a great team of 20+ nationalities in our English-speaking office    Occupational pension at ITP1 level    Flexible Public Holidays Policy    Options Program    Parental pay top-up    Wellness allowance    Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office) The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 52,000-66,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.This is a full-time position based at our Stockholm headquarters. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds! If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear from you.Feel free to include a link to your GitHub or anything you've built or operated that you're proud of.How we hireWe use generative AI to assist the people running our recruitment process, for example in preparing interviews. People are in the loop at every stage, and every decision about your application is made by a human.

You look beyond individual features and releases to understand the end-to-end customer journey, focusing QA where it matters most — across experimentation, analytics and tracking, payments, and the different devices, browsers, and in-app browsers our users rely on.You lead and develop our QA team while continuously improving how we work. Through smarter testing strategies, automation, AI, and modern QA practices, you help reduce repetitive manual work, catch more meaningful issues, and enable faster development and release cycles.Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden.What you will be doing    Own the QA strategy and operating model for Product Growth, defining what we test, how we test it, and where QA effort creates the most value    Lead, coach, and develop our QA team, supporting their performance, career development, and growing capabilities in areas such as automation    Take an end-to-end view prioritization to shorten the time from idea to launch without compromising quality    Drive the adoption of test automation, AI, and modern tooling to make QA more effective and scalable    Lead the Marketing, Design, Analytics, and other teams when needed to ensure quality across the broader customer journey    Build a strong quality mindset across Product Growth, making QA an integrated part of product development rather than a final step before releaseWhat skills and experience we think you have    QA leadership: Experience leading and developing QA professionals and owning QA strategy, processes, and ways of working    Growth product experience: Strong experience testing growth-oriented digital products, including commercial funnels, experimentation/A/B testing, analytics and tracking, conversion journeys, and fast-moving product environments    End-to-end quality mindset: You think beyond individual features and understand quality across complete user journeys, including different browsers, devices, entry points, and systems    Test automation: Hands-on experience with test automation — whether through implementation, technical evaluation, or close collaboration with automation engineers — strong enough to guide framework and tooling decisions for our stack    AI and modern QA practices: Experience using AI and modern QA tooling to improve testing efficiency, effectiveness, or scalability    Commercial understanding: Experience with areas such as payments, pricing, subscriptions, or other high-impact commercial flows    Strategic and pragmatic thinking: Balances a clear long-term view of where QA needs to go with pragmatic, in-the-moment trade-off calls under time pressure.    Risk-based prioritization: Ability to identify where the biggest quality risks lie — including dependencies between features, experiments, and user journeys — and guide the team on where deeper testing or other quality measures deliver the most value.    Cross-functional leadership: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and other partnersIt's a plus if you also have    Experience across both web and mobile apps    Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks    Experience with subscription-based products    Experience working in a regulated or consumer health environment    Passion for women's healthWhat we offer    Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location    Professional development - you will collaborate with industry leading developers, promoting continuous growth and skill enhancement    Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work    Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value    Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development LocationWe are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you! jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: AI for Real-Time Microstructure Monitoring Using Laser Ultra
jobs.description: Project Description Background Laser Ultrasonics (LUS) is a powerful non-contact technique for in-situ characterization of metallic materials at elevated temperatures. In hot strip mill environments, LUS enables real-time monitoring of grain size evolution through analysis of ultrasonic wave attenuation and velocity, providing critical insight into recrystallization, grain growth, and phase transformations. This information is highly valuable for advanced process control strategies aimed at improving product quality, consistency, and resource efficiency. The NAICE project (Non-destructive AI enhanced online grain size evaluation) addresses a key challenge in fossil free steel production: today’s steel mills lack real time information about the microstructure that governs material quality, leading to unnecessary energy use, scrap, and slow process adjustments. By upgrading the world’s only industrial laser ultrasonic grain size gauge and collecting a unique large dataset, the project will train models to enable AI enhanced measurement of the grain size and microstructure in real-time. This enables smarter process control, higher yield, and reduced emissions. This thesis is the first of two planned master thesis works. The first will evaluate the best options using historical data sets, whereas the second will focus on using the full dataset and optimizing the model for industrial implementation. If you want to know more about the LUS technology and the installation of the world’s only grain size gauge there is a recorded webinar here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZOpXUAPhEv0&t=665s  Thesis Scope The thesis will focus on the application of machine learning and AI techniques to Laser Ultrasonic (LUS) data acquired in a hot strip mill environment. The available dataset consists of:     Raw LUS A-scan signals with multiple backwall echoes (20 µs duration, 1 ns resolution)     Grain size values calculated using an established conventional algorithm (serving as reference values)     The primary objective is to develop and evaluate AI-based approaches for: - Grain size prediction directly from raw laser ultrasonic signals - Microstructure state classification (e.g., recrystallized fraction, pancaking/aspect ratio) A key part of the work will be to survey suitable AI architectures, such as time-series models, deep learning approaches, and alternative signal-processing-informed models, and assess their applicability to the LUS data. Tasks     Survey and critically assess relevant AI/ML architectures for ultrasonic time-series data     Pre-process and structure high-resolution LUS A-scan datasets for model training     Develop and implement selected AI models     Perform benchmark comparisons between different approaches with respect to:      Prediction accuracy     Robustness to signal variability     Computational efficiency and suitability for real-time deployment     Analyze model interpretability in relation to known physical phenomena Expected Outcomes The thesis should deliver:     A structured comparison of candidate AI approaches for LUS-based grain size prediction     Prototype models demonstrating feasibility on the historical dataset     Recommendations for model selection in future industrial implementation Desired Qualifications We are looking for a motivated student with:     A background in computer engineering, engineering physics, materials science, applied mathematics, or similar     Strong interest in machine learning and signal processing     Experience with Python/Matlab and ML frameworks     Basic understanding of wave physics, ultrasonics, or materials science (meriting but not required)     Analytical mindset and ability to work with complex datasets Additional Information     The work will be carried out in close collaboration with experts in Laser Ultrasonics and industrial process monitoring, providing a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge development of AI-driven process control in steel manufacturing. Project time The project is intended for a master thesis (30hp), starting in spring 2027 or can be mutually decided through negotiations. Further information This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp). Contacts For further information please contact:      Mikael Malmström, mikael.malmstrom@swerim.se     Hampus Wikmark Kreuger, hampus.wikmark@swerim.se Application Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in Swedish (or English). You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means there is no explicit deadline.
